Class CaveManager

Namespace
MemoryBadger.Caves

MemoryBadger.dll

A smart code cave class for managing smaller "CodeCaves" within one code cave, preventing the need to create many codes caves just for one mod.

Dispose()

This is the mandatory IDisposable method. It triggers automatically whenever a 'using' block ends. Frees the code cave and closes all CodeCave and Detour instances managed by the CaveManager before clearing the Detour.
